summary: Short kerb at a junction corner, house 12 m behind, cars park here.

best_section.where: West kerb of Manchester Terrace opposite the Rokeby Terrace junction, by the grass verge

drivers.seclusion: Residential block 12 m behind the kerb at the start and another dwelling 19 m away; homes all round within 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a grass verge and parked cars along the kerb; room for one van, then the road curves into the junction.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, junction just south.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb in Esri; No Stopping Any Time signs sit about 12 m off, on the junction arms.

flags: House 12 m away on the same side
Junction close; No Stopping signs nearby
sun_shade: Open to the sky; units to the west shade the kerb late in the day.
cannot_judge: Exact reach of the no-stopping signs
